# demo-skill: settings (Layer 2)
 
See context/layer2-standards.md. Standards apply without asking; a client can request a change for their instance.
 
## Standards
| Setting | Standard |
|---|---|
| schedule | Every hour during working hours |
| filing_mode | First run: preview only. Never delete. |
| quiet_runs | A run with nothing new posts nothing. Failures go to #<agent>-ops. |
 
## Client answers
| Setting | Comes from | Suggested answer | Value |
|---|---|---|---|
| extra urgent_rules | Q1 | Anything with a deadline or a payment problem | |
| sender_rules / suppression_rules | Q2 | Promotions and newsletters stay out of the summary | |
| critical_senders | Q3 | Our clients and our accountant | |
